suggested_requirements.text: The system shall provide the ability to perform data validation on National Bridge Inventory items.

The user shall be able to select structures by structure ID, district, county, administrative area, ownership, custodianship, functional class, NHS status, on/off system, inspector, bridge group, inspection due dates, and all or some environment and elements.

The user shall be able to find structures based on the structure ID, structure name, feature intersected, facility carried, route number, LRS Inventory Route, KM/mile posts, structure types, design types and materials, and by searching the notes fields.
The system shall display the data in the appropriate unit of measurement as configured for the application.
The user shall be able to select bridges on a supported map display and generate a bridge list for use within Pontis.
The user shall be able to create a new structure by copying all data of an existing structure.
The system shall provide the capability to lock down an inspection record once signed and sealed to prevent deletion or modification.
The system shall be capable of calculating NBI condition ratings using the FHWA NBI Translator.
The system shall be capable of calculating and storing bridge Sufficiency Rating.
The system shall be capable of calculating appraisal ratings.
The system shall be capable of calculating Structurally Deficient/Functionally Obsolete status.
The system shall be capable of running a program simulation for a selected set of structures and storing the simulation results in the Pontis database.
The system shall guarantee atomic database transactions to ensure maximum data integrity.
The system shall be capable of validating user name and password during log-in process.
The system shall be capable of operating with a single-sign-on authentication mechanism based on Active Directory Services or the LDAP standard.
The information contained in the system must be secure, with access limited to appropriate staff and agency-designated parties.
The system must be reliable and in operation at an acceptable level of availability and performance.
The software must enable users to access the majority of data and capabilities without specialized technical skills or training.
Pontis 5.0 must be a Microsoft .NET application.
Pontis 5.0 must support its existing relational databases of Sybase Adaptive Server Anywhere, Oracle, and Microsoft SQL Server.
Pontis 5.0 must be a GIS-aware application that operates properly within an agency’s GIS technology.
